scope: 435 historical province-wide physician-payment category/year observations, not recipient or transaction records
checks: All 435 source CSV rows independently matched to exact labels, decimal tokens, record numbers and canonical row hashes

Historical frozen CSV, not a live transaction ledger or comprehensive spending coverage
Application admission, decimal display and hosted behavior require separate verification
